definitions.iou: V002 missing output = all-frame zero; cropped visible support only; NOT a motion pass criterion
definitions.swap: Nearest-center opposition proxy only, not an identity verdict
definitions.ssim: RGB local 7x7, sample covariance, range255; mean on anchor/output object union; anchor LANCZOS resize/crop matches model input
definitions.background: Consecutive RGB MAE outside union of both POST edit regions; reflections excluded
definitions.upright: bbox height/width proxy; missing frames never pass; reference upper band reported separately

definitions.iou: Visible scaled source body mask vs fixed-cast actual output. Missing detected output gets zero in all-frame mean; unavailable artifacts or casting are null.
definitions.direction: Shared scaled_geometry.direction: median x of topmost pixel row relative to bbox center. Four-quadrant comparable mean and full-window missing/axis penalty both reported.
definitions.caveat: Topmost point may be head or ear, not a kicking leg. No automatic motion or quality ranking.
definitions.clipping: Reused CPU control evidence, not a measurement of generated output clipping.

limitations: Brightness ratio is a transparency proxy, not alpha recovery.
Laplacian includes mask-cut boundaries and may reflect texture or noise.
Observed-only aggregates retain missing coverage; no automatic ranking.
Kling lighting and body size differ; reference only.
